limits.access.unavailableBody: This feature is not available for this organization.
limits.access.unavailableHelp: Contact the administrator of this installation to make it available.
limits.banner.readOnlyBody: This feature is no longer available for this organization. You can still view and export its data; changes are turned off. Contact the administrator of this installation to keep it.
limits.console.defaults.confirmDesc: Applies to organizations people create from now on. Nothing changes for existing organizations. The change is recorded in the admin audit log.
limits.console.defaults.conflict: Another administrator changed the default limits. The latest values are shown.
limits.console.defaults.description: The limits an organization starts with when a person creates it themselves. Leave a value empty for no limit (the default). Organizations created in this console have no limits, and existing organizations keep theirs.
limits.console.defaults.saveError: Could not save the default limits
limits.console.defaults.superOnly: Only a super admin can change them.
limits.console.defaults.title: Limits of self-service organizations
limits.console.expiryPast: Pick a date in the future.
limits.console.invalidValue: Use a whole number of 0 or more, or leave it empty for no limit.
limits.console.org.description: No limit applies unless one is set. A lower limit never removes anything: new additions over it are refused.
limits.console.org.dialogDesc: Now {current}. Recorded in the admin audit log.
limits.console.org.needsOps: Changing a limit needs an operations admin.
limits.console.org.removeDesc: The organization is no longer limited by it, unless the service operator set one.
limits.console.org.title: Limits
limits.console.page.description: Limits of organizations on this installation. None apply unless you set them.
limits.console.page.title: Limits
limits.denied.description: These modules are not available for this organization. Its data is kept.
limits.denied.title: Modules not available
limits.moduleLock.readOnlyHint: This module is no longer available for this organization. Its data can be viewed and exported until then; changes are turned off.
limits.moduleLock.unavailableHint: This module is not available for this organization. Contact the administrator of this installation.
limits.none.description: This organization has no limits and every module is available.
limits.none.title: No limits apply
limits.notCounted: Counted while a limit is set
limits.onboarding.hint: Pick what this team does first; you can switch modules on or off later in Settings > Modules. Leave empty to start with every module.
limits.overLimitNotice: Nothing was removed. New additions of the items marked over limit are refused until some are removed or the limit is raised.
limits.usage.description: What this organization may add. To change a limit, contact the administrator of this installation.
limits.usage.title: Limits
